summary: Implemented the `append` update operation in `tinydb.operations` for appending values to list fields in TinyDB documents. If the field exists, `append` adds the value as a single element to the end of the list; if absent, it initializes the field with a fresh single-element list. Added comprehensive acceptance tests in `tests/test_autose_issue_3.py` verifying criteria AC-1 through AC-6.
